title: Speaker for the Dead
author: Orson Scott Card
engineRationale: Deliberate inverse of Ender's Game: no fleet, no Battle Room. The book is a domestic mystery and a moral argument — the Ribeira kitchen, a eulogy, guilt, grief, and the Hierarchy of Foreignness (utlanning/framling/raman/varelse), which is literally a four-tier diagram. Its non-human subjects (pequeninos, the descolada, sentient trees) go uncanny under photoreal Flux, while an everyman family constellation + kinetic typography + explanatory diagrams is exactly Antidote 4.0's lane.
